```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r}
smk_job_runtimes <-fromJSON("../../../../OrCA-seq_snakemake/OrCA-seq-processing/runtimes.json") %>% 
  as.data.frame %>% 
  dplyr::select(data.values.rule, data.values.runtime) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Job" = "data.values.rule", 
                "Time" = "data.values.runtime") %>%
  mutate(
    Job = case_when(
      Job == "pychopper" ~ "Pychopper",
      Job == "cutadapt_sp5" ~ "Demultiplex round 1",
      Job == "cutadapt_sp27" ~ "Demultiplex round 2",
      Job == "amplicon_sorter" ~ "AmpliconSorter",
      Job == "primer_removal" ~ "Primer removal",
      Job == "barrnap_extract" ~ "Barrnap extraction",
      Job == "reorganize_cois" ~ "Reorganise COIs")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Job = factor(Job, levels = c("Pychopper",
                                                "Demultiplex round 1",
                                                "Demultiplex round 2",
                                                "AmpliconSorter",
                                                "Primer removal",
                                                "Barrnap extraction",
                                                "Reorganise COIs")))
average_times <-
  smk_job_runtimes %>% 
  group_by(Job) %>% 
  summarize(mean_seconds = mean(Time),
            sum_seconds = sum(Time)) %>% 
  mutate(mean_minutes = mean_seconds/60,
         mean_hours = mean_minutes/60,
         sum_minutes = sum_seconds/60,
         sum_hours = sum_minutes/60)

cumulative <- smk_job_runtimes %>%
  group_by(Job) %>%
  summarise(Job_Total = sum(Time), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Job) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_time = cumsum(Job_Total))

axis_breaks <- 10^(-1:5)
axis_labels <- scales::label_number(big.mark = ",", drop0trailing = TRUE)

runtimes_plot<-
  smk_job_runtimes %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Job, y = Time, color = Job)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_line(data = cumulative,
            aes(x = Job, y = cumulative_time, group = 1),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = axis_breaks,
    labels = axis_labels,
    sec.axis = dup_axis(name = "Cumulative time (seconds)\nscaled log10, for all Jobs")
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(x = "Job",
       y = "Time (seconds)\nscaled log10 per Job") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(margin = margin(l = 15)))

ggsave("plots/snakemake_runtimes.pdf", runtimes_plot, width = 5, height = 4)
```
